meaning: a person you work with
example: My colleagues are very friendly.

meaning: a person who buys things from a shop or business
example: The customer is always right.

meaning: the money you get every month for your job
example: She has a good salary.

meaning: working the whole week, about 40 hours
example: I have a full-time job.

meaning: working only part of the day or week
example: He works part-time in a café.

meaning: a time when people come together to talk about something
example: I have a meeting at ten.

meaning: to get money for work
example: How much does a nurse earn?

meaning: a person who is in charge of a team or a shop
example: Can I speak to the manager?

meaning: a person who works for a company
example: The company has 200 employees.

meaning: a business that makes or sells things
example: I work for a big company.

meaning: special clothes that people wear for a job
example: Nurses wear a uniform.

meaning: a period of work, often at night or at the weekend
example: I'm working the night shift this week.

meaning: a day when you don't go to work
example: Tomorrow is my day off.

meaning: to stop working because of age
example: My dad retired last year.

meaning: a meeting where someone asks you questions for a job
example: I have a job interview tomorrow.

meaning: to ask officially for a job
example: She applied for a job at the bank.

meaning: the jobs you do during your working life
example: She wants a career in fashion.

meaning: a message you send on the computer
example: I answer about fifty emails a day.

meaning: needing rest or sleep
example: I'm always tired after work.

meaning: not interesting
example: My first job was really boring.

meaning: making you want to know more
example: Teaching is an interesting job.

meaning: to travel to work and back every day
example: I commute by train.

meaning: without a job
example: He's been unemployed for six months.

meaning: to give someone a job
example: The restaurant is hiring new staff.

meaning: to make someone leave their job (informal)
example: He was fired for being late every day.

meaning: to leave your job because you want to
example: She quit her job to travel.

meaning: a move to a more important job in the same company
example: She got a promotion after two years.

meaning: an increase in your pay (British English: rise)
example: I'm going to ask for a raise.

meaning: the time by which you must finish something
example: The deadline is Friday at noon.

meaning: extra hours you work after your normal time
example: I did ten hours of overtime this week.

meaning: knowledge and skill you get by doing a job
example: Do you have any experience in sales?

meaning: an official record that you have passed an exam or course
example: What qualifications do you need for this job?

meaning: an ability to do something well
example: Communication is an important skill.

meaning: a document with your education and work history (British English: CV)
example: Send your resume to the HR department.

meaning: teaching people the skills for a job
example: New staff get two weeks of training.

meaning: to do your job at home instead of in an office
example: I work from home on Fridays.

meaning: working for yourself, not for a company
example: My dad is self-employed: he's a plumber.

meaning: having the job of looking after something
example: I'm responsible for the company website.

meaning: controlling or managing something
example: Who's in charge of the project?

meaning: causing worry and pressure
example: Being a doctor is very stressful.

meaning: making you feel satisfied and useful
example: Teaching is hard but rewarding.

meaning: earning a lot of money
example: Lawyers have well-paid jobs.

meaning: the balance between time at work and time for yourself
example: I want a better work-life balance.

meaning: to accept a job or responsibility
example: I can't take on any more work.

meaning: the amount of work a person has to do
example: My workload has doubled this year.

meaning: extreme tiredness caused by working too hard for too long
example: Many nurses are suffering from burnout.

meaning: knowing that you will not lose your job
example: Civil servants have good job security.

meaning: an extra advantage of a job, like a free phone or a car
example: Free lunch is one of the perks of the job.

meaning: time off work for a mother before and after having a baby
example: She's on maternity leave until June.

meaning: the act of ending workers' jobs because there is not enough work
example: The company announced 500 layoffs.

meaning: working for different companies, not employed by one
example: She's a freelance translator.

meaning: a job market of short-term, freelance work, often through apps
example: Delivery riders are part of the gig economy.

meaning: to find and offer a job to someone who works for another company
example: She was headhunted by a rival firm.

meaning: to discuss to reach an agreement
example: Always negotiate your salary.

meaning: to give part of your work to someone else
example: A good manager knows how to delegate.

meaning: to control every small detail of someone's work
example: I hate it when my boss micromanages me.

meaning: acting before problems happen, not waiting

meaning: needing a lot of time, energy and skill
example: It's a demanding job, but I love it.

meaning: to move up to better jobs over time
example: He climbed the career ladder quickly.

meaning: to stop working for the day
example: It's seven o'clock. Let's call it a day.

meaning: informed about what is happening
example: Please keep me in the loop.

meaning: starting again because a plan failed
example: The client hated it, so it's back to the drawing board.

meaning: to tell your employer you are going to leave
example: I handed in my notice yesterday.

meaning: looking for a new job
example: I've been job-hunting for three months.

meaning: a person who starts their own business
example: She's a young entrepreneur with three companies.

meaning: working from a place outside the office, usually from home
example: Remote work became normal after 2020.
